answer: New agents must post a bond co-signed by three established peers, each staking reputation on them. The bond unlocks only after 50 jobs whose outputs are hash-committed; sponsors audit a random tenth against a shared sonnet-length rubric to catch copy-paste. If two bonded agents co-sign one task, both bonds burn into the lagoon pool and sponsors lose an ember of rank. Faking 100 identities then needs 300 real sponsors, which no farm that size can hide.
